## Source transcript for Marauder v1.17.0. Not a lab capture.
## This machine had no Scout UART (only a Flipper USB port). Lines below are the
## Serial prints at the cited tag, with the password replaced by ***.
##
## scanall is the AP-table scan. CommandLine.cpp:980-983 starts WIFI_SCAN_AP_STA.
## RunAPScan (WiFiScan.cpp:4169) installs apSnifferCallbackFull, which
## access_points->add at WiFiScan.cpp:7346. sniffbeacon only prints beacons
## (WiFiScan.cpp:8702) and does not add to access_points, so join -a cannot use it.
## list and join are outside if (!scanning()) (CommandLine.cpp:1603 and :1722).
## StopScan (WiFiScan.cpp:2986) does not clear access_points.
## list -a format is CommandLine.cpp:1626 and :1630.
## showCounts ends the list (CommandLine.cpp:172-178).
## join prints "Using SSID: " (CommandLine.cpp:1731) then "Connecting to WiFi"
## and dots (WiFiScan.cpp:2334-2337). The only fail sentence is
## "Could not connect to WiFi network" (WiFiScan.cpp:2346), after 20 x delay(500).
## save_credential defaults true (WiFiScan.h joinWiFi). No success sentence.
## CLI gui=false does not print "IP address:". The command prompt is "> " with
## no newline (CommandLine.cpp:87), so a successful Connecting line is not a
## complete line until the next println. FAP sends `channel` as a serial
## barrier; its echo may have the Connecting text glued in front.
## Historical join -s lines in other fixture records are not the current flow.
## Count 0: "There are no saved WiFi credentials" (CommandLine.cpp:1749).
## Probe connect: "Connected to saved WiFi: " plus the same essid.
## Missing args: "You did not provide the proper args" (CommandLine.cpp:1753).
##
#list -a
[0][CH:6] HomeNet -42
[1][CH:44] Cafe Guest -70 (selected)
1 selected
Scanning for APs and Stations. Stop with stopscan
#join -a 0 -p ***
Using SSID: HomeNet
Could not connect to WiFi network
You did not provide the proper args
